first: the buzzer doesn't let my guests in anymore

tenant.situation: Visitors can call your unit from the lobby panel and you hear them, but pressing the door-release button on your handset doesn't unlock the lobby door.

knows.call: the call comes through, you can talk both ways
knows.door: you press the door button and nothing clicks downstairs
knows.neighbours: you don't know if others have the same problem
knows.tried: pressed it several times and longer

doesnt_know: whether it's your handset or the door strike

truth.problem: lobby door strike or the unit's release circuit failed

judge: Separates the parts: the call works, only the door release fails.
Asks whether neighbours are affected, which tells the manager if it's the door or one handset.

tenant.situation: The garbage chute door on your floor won't take a bag: the chute is full up to your floor. It smells.

knows.how_full: bags piled up right to the door on your floor
knows.tried: nothing, left your bag in your unit

truth.problem: garbage chute jammed below the 5th floor

judge: Tells the tenant not to push more bags in or try to clear it, and where to take garbage meanwhile.
The ticket names the floor so the caretaker knows where the blockage is.

first: the garage door is stuck halfway

tenant.situation: The building's parkade door stopped halfway up and won't move with your remote. Cars can't get in or out.

knows.position: about halfway open, tilted a little
knows.remote: your remote and the wall button do nothing
knows.noise: it made a loud bang before it stopped
knows.cars: a couple of cars are waiting to get out

doesnt_know: whether a spring or cable broke

truth.problem: broken parkade door spring or cable

judge: Warns people to stay out from under the door and not force it, given the bang (likely a broken spring).
Treats it as urgent since cars are trapped.

first: elevator broken again and i'm in a wheelchair, i cant get out

tenant.situation: The building's only elevator is out of service. You use a wheelchair and live on the 6th floor. You have a medical appointment this afternoon.

knows.elevator: the only elevator, doors won't open and the call button doesn't light
knows.stuck_inside: no one is stuck inside as far as you know

truth.problem: elevator out of service; a tenant who uses a wheelchair is stranded

judge: Recognises the tenant can't leave and flags the ticket high priority with the wheelchair noted.
Checks that nobody is trapped inside, and mentions the elevator service company/911 only if someone is.

first: the washer in the laundry room ate my money

tenant.situation: In the basement laundry room, washer #2 took your coins but didn't start.

knows.which: washer #2, the one by the window

truth.problem: coin mechanism jammed on a shared washer

judge: Gets which machine and how much money, so the manager can refund and put an out-of-order sign up.
Doesn't suggest prying at the coin slot.

first: la lumière dans le corridor au 3e est brulée, c'est noir le soir

tenant.situation: Le plafonnier du corridor du 3e étage, près de l'escalier, ne s'allume plus. Le soir c'est très sombre.

knows.where: corridor du 3e, au bout près de la cage d'escalier
knows.dark: le soir on voit mal les marches

doesnt_know: si c'est l'ampoule ou le luminaire

truth.problem: burnt-out common-area light fixture near the stairwell

judge: Replies in French and doesn't ask the tenant to change the bulb in a common area.
Notes it's by the stairs, which makes it a tripping hazard worth fixing soon.

first: 停车场的门打不开，车出不去了

tenant.situation: 地下停车场出口的门不开了，用遥控器和感应都没反应。你要开车去上班。

knows.which: 地下停车场出口那个卷帘门
knows.remote: 遥控器按了没反应，车开过去感应也不开
knows.tried: 按了好几次遥控器，换了电池

truth.problem: parkade gate opener lost power or failed

judge: Replies in Chinese and treats it as urgent because residents' cars are trapped.
Doesn't tell the tenant to force the gate or pull a release.

first: front lobby door doesnt close all the way anymore, anyone can just walk in

tenant.situation: The building's front lobby door swings shut slowly and stops a few centimetres open, so the lock doesn't catch. Anyone can push it open.

knows.gap: stays open about 3 cm, doesn't latch
knows.closer: the arm at the top seems loose and leaks a bit of oil
knows.strangers: you saw someone you didn't recognise come in
knows.tried: pulled it shut by hand, it latches if you push hard

truth.problem: failed door closer on the lobby entrance; building not secure

judge: Treats an unlocked main entrance as a high-priority security problem.
Doesn't ask the tenant to adjust the door closer themselves.

first: my mailbox door is hanging off, anyone could take my mail. got a pic

tenant.situation: The small door of your mailbox in the lobby bank is hanging by one hinge and won't lock.

knows.damage: top hinge snapped, door hangs open, lock won't line up
knows.since: found it like that this morning
knows.forced: looks like it might have been pried, a bent edge

truth.problem: broken mailbox door, possibly pried open

judge: Takes the photo and asks which mailbox, then logs it.
If the tenant says it looks pried, suggests reporting a possible theft to Canada Post or police and holding mail meanwhile.
